text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-President Hrawi discussed with Syrian President Assad in three separate meetings peace issues and Lebanese internal problems.
-Parliament Speaker Berri: Syria provides Lebanon with the stability needed to resist Israeli occupation.
-Patriarch Sfeir warns against growing social hardship.
-Israeli artillery shelled areas on the edge of the south Lebanon occupation zone.
-Lebanon to present the cases of Lebanese captives in Israeli jails to the U.N. human rights commission in Geneva.
-A regional conference on railroads will held in Lebanon.
-U.S. ambassador Jones says a wide-scale Israeli military operation on south Lebanon is a remote possibility.
